title: AI-Assisted Discovery and Construction of a Counterexample to the Convergence of Three-Block ADMM with the Identity Matrix as its Third Constraint Block
abstract: arXiv:2608.14396v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM), as a landmark algorithm, has attracted tremendous research attention and extensive practical applications over the past two decades. It is well known that, although the two-block ADMM enjoys well-established theoretical convergence guarantees, its direct extension to the three-block case may fail to converge, as demonstrated by existing counterexamples [5]. However, to the best of our knowledge, the case in which the third constraint block is the identity remains unresolved: the existing literature gives neither a general convergence proof nor a counterexample for this subclass. In this paper, we give a negative answer: direct three-block ADMM may fail even when the first two blocks are strongly convex quadratics. translated_title: 人工智能辅助发现并构造一个以单位矩阵作为第三约束块的三块ADMM收敛性反例
translated_abstract: 交替方向乘子法（ADMM）作为一项标志性算法，在过去二十年中引起了大量研究关注和广泛的实际应用。众所周知，尽管两块ADMM具有完善的理论收敛保证，但其直接扩展到三块情况时可能不收敛，这一点已通过现有反例[5]得到证实。然而，据我们所知，第三约束块为单位矩阵的情况仍未解决：现有文献既未给出该子类的一般收敛性证明，也未提供反例。本文给出了否定答案：即使前两块为强凸二次函数，直接三块ADMM也可能不收敛。利用Codex与GPT-5.6 Sol，我们构造了一个显式的有理反例候选，并沿分段仿射约简路径进行验证；精确检查表明，该反例成立。
tldr: 本文首次证明，即使前两块为强凸二次函数，直接三块ADMM在第三约束块为单位矩阵时仍可能不收敛，并利用AI辅助构造并验证了显式反例。
en_tdlr: This paper proves for the first time that direct three-block ADMM may fail to converge even with strongly convex quadratics in the first two blocks and the identity matrix as the third constraint block, constructing and verifying an explicit counterexample via AI assistance.
